breaks.expected: A purchase whose lineage the provider explicitly reports as lapsed (record for the same product with original_purchase_date equal to the evidence's purchase date, expired, no active entitlement) must settle to a terminal 'expired' verdict so the mobile pending record clears. On the head the mobile store keeps the pending record while outcome='pending' (apps/mobile/src/state/accessStore.ts, only 'fulfilled' clears; ADV-M1 in apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/billingEntitlementAdversary.test.ts shows pending blocks BOTH Continue and Restore and persists across relaunch), so a subscriber whose first sync did not complete before the first renewal (sandbox monthly renews every 5 min during App Review; trial/intro conversion; production month/year) is locked out of re-purchasing after lapse. docs/RELEASE_READINESS_2026-09-07.md §W07 lists 'renewal also replaces the latest subscription transaction → valid purchases can remain pending indefinitely' as a known blocker to close with post-renewal cases; the head closed numeric-id and lifetime, not this one. INFERRED: ADV-3b (id replaced) is the shape RevenueCat's v1 customer-info model documents (purchase_date = latest renewal, store_transaction_id = latest transaction); ADV-3a is the weaker variant.
breaks.observed: POST /v1/billing/sync with fulfilment evidence {productId: pickle_sensei_pro_monthly, transactionId: '1000000652379790', purchasedAt: 2026-06-01T00:00:00.000Z} against a RevenueCat subscriber whose only pickle_sensei_pro_monthly record has original_purchase_date 2026-06-01, purchase_date 2026-07-01 (the renewal), expires_date 1h ago, no entitlement → HTTP 200, billing.premium=false, fulfilment.outcome='pending' in both variants (store_transaction_id kept = ADV-3a; store_transaction_id replaced by the renewal's = ADV-3b). Assertion diff: '- pending / + expired'. billingFulfilmentOf() (supabase/functions/api/index.ts) matches candidates only on providerTransactionIdentity(row) === transactionId AND isoTimestamp(row.purchase_date) === purchasedAt, never consulting original_purchase_date, so after the first renewal no provider record can ever equal the durable evidence.
